other_conditions: Project must be innovative and use out‑of‑the‑box or cutting‑edge technology
Project must address a critical problem or need of the district
Project must directly benefit the district community
Project must create employment and generate revenue for the community or the State
Project must add value to agricultural, horticultural, textile or handicraft products and ensure better remuneration
Project must demonstrate a sustainable and continuous improvement plan
benefits_summary: The scheme supports innovative district projects that bridge infrastructure gaps, generate employment and add value to local products.
